forms={
'hill':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*t**q[2]/(q[3]+t**q[2]),[0,-13,1,3]),
'exp':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*np.exp(-q[2]*t),[-12,12,.3]),
'atan':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*np.arctan(q[2]*t+q[3]),[0,-8,.3,0]),
'tanh':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*np.tanh(q[2]*t+q[3]),[0,-12,.2,0]),
'2exp':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*np.exp(-q[2]*t)+q[3]*np.exp(-q[4]*t),[-12,6,.1,6,.5]),
'expcos':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*np.exp(-q[2]*t)*np.cos(q[3]*t+q[4]),[-12,12,.3,.3,0]),
'sqrt-rat':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*t/np.sqrt(q[2]+t**2),[0,-12,9]),
'log(1+)pow':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*np.log(1+q[2]*t**q[3]),[0,-4,1,1]),
'expsqrt':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*np.exp(-q[2]*np.sqrt(t)),[-13,14,.4]),
'ratquad':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]/(1+q[2]*t+q[3]*t*t),[-13,14,.3,0.01]),
'sin':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*np.sin(q[2]*t+q[3])+q[4]*t,[-6,6,.2,1.5,0]),
'1mexp/t':(lambda q:q[0]+q[1]*(1-np.exp(-q[2]*t))/t,[-12,10,.3]),
}
for k,(fn,q0) in forms.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(6):
        rng=np.random.default_rng(s)
        try:

            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as e: pass
